registry.localOffice: The municipal service catalog identifies Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda, Departamento de Impostos Imobiliários, for cadastral property data; the municipal geoprocessing pages identify the public map service.
registry.sourceScope: Municipal geoprocessing map with an official Lotes layer; the service review records the bounded anonymous query scope and limitations.
registry.geometryAccess: Anonymous public p.mapper service returned a safe parcel ID and a geometry extent at the exact WUP point. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe owner/address fields, or TLS weakening were used.

geometry.exactWupPointTest: Performed without moving the WUP point. The point was transformed only for the service request to approximate UTM zone 23S coordinates (589747.98, 7509486.47); the bounded map query returned one Lotes feature with native ID 240 and a service geometry extent.
geometry.crs: Service coordinates are metre-based UTM-like coordinates; the public configuration did not explicitly publish an EPSG code. The service review records the observed extent and CRS uncertainty.
